status: Exploratory source-data reanalysis specified after inspecting numerical blocks; not preregistered or independent validation.
question: Which measured thin-layer material results can inform an intended-depth/interface qualification, and which source hierarchy or identity gaps prevent stronger inference?
source_citation: Hasan A, Chuvilin A, Van Teijlingen A et al. Biomimetic supramolecular protein matrix restores structure and properties of human dental enamel. Nature Communications 16, 9434 (2025). DOI 10.1038/s41467-025-64982-y.

series.hierarchy: Three caption-aligned values; methods specify at least 5 indents/sample. Sample/donor IDs and indentation-to-sample mapping absent from the selected block.
Three caption-aligned values; underlying repeated indentations cannot increase independent sample count.
Three caption-aligned values; direct donor linkage to native/acid groups is not supplied.
Methods use 32 extracted molars, 8 per substrate/condition. Row-to-molar and molar-to-donor IDs absent.
Group consists of 8 caption-reported samples; row position is not a donor pairing.
Height and volume concern the same source groups, not independent replications; individual cross-endpoint mapping unverified.
No specimen-ID crosswalk supplied; no paired tests or joint-attainment claim.
Conditional first 8-value block aligned to caption count and height-block length; an unlabeled ninth number remains unresolved.
The extra numeric cell is retained with identity unknown, not promoted to a ninth specimen.
Eight caption-aligned values; no ninth height value, donor or specimen identifier is supplied.
Eight caption-aligned values; no pooling with enamel or fracture specimens.

statistics.primary_dispersion: Descriptive sample SD with denominator n_values-1; not a standard error or confidence interval.
statistics.source_dispersion_audit: Also report population-divisor SD of the exact listed values to inspect the relation to rounded article SDs; do not silently change conventions.
statistics.unlabeled_values: Compare trailing value to first 8 mean and median; retain exact cell, style, formula and adjacent-label checks. All 9-numeric-values sensitivity is bookkeeping only, not 9 specimens or a summary-cell interpretation.
statistics.no_inference: No p-values, paired tests, confidence intervals, equivalence claims, donor count or clinical uncertainty inferred from unlabeled source positions.

limits: Apparent indentation fracture toughness is not bulk KIc, host-repair interfacial toughness or full-crown fatigue resistance.
Wear groups compare untreated native tissue with a preparation-plus-mineralization process; there is no acid-etched-only wear arm in the selected figures.
Neither lack of reported statistical significance nor similar group means proves native-tissue equivalence.
No per-specimen layer-depth map, donor linkage, depth/property pairing, crack-path/interface load curve, living PDL or support-withdrawal endpoint is supplied by these numerical blocks.
No growth rate, repeat-cycle forecast, human dose, application procedure or clinical lifespan conversion is generated.
